disclosure: Path-redacted structured evidence; raw local originals retained, hash identifies unmodified original. Redacted text is not claimed byte-identical to raw. Historical experiment identity remains distinct from final artifact qualification.

observed.result: 6 high-confidence self-created fixture counterexamples; no shared source writes
observed.source_binding: storage-results.json baseline and end_hashes match; final-readable-file-hashes.json confirms other reviewed implementation files unchanged after workflow/native probes. core.py and workspace.py handed back to main for fixes and not reread after handoff. Locations below are baseline locations.

findings.title: Inferior stdout is accepted as an actual GDB breakpoint hit
findings.input: Self-built C: never_called() exists but main only puts("TRACEANCHOR_BREAK never_called"). Run professional.run native.trace with breakpoints=[never_called].
findings.actual: Real GDB 16.3 exits normally without entering never_called; observation status=complete, breakpoint_hits=[{symbol:never_called,line:4}], unknowns=[]. Raw trace contains no debugger-generated info args/backtrace from the breakpoint commands.
findings.cause: Regex searches merged GDB/inferior stdout for a public fixed marker; no debugger event/channel identity or actual stop receipt is required.
findings.impact: P01 runtime evidence can assert a function was executed when only target text contained the marker.

findings.title: Revising a linked child expands effects beyond its read-only parent
findings.input: Create read-only parent and subtask. case.revise child changes.allowed_effects=[read,execute], then capture a self-written child Python source.
findings.actual: Child revision succeeds and capture status=completed, stdout='child executed beyond parent contract'. Parent allowed_effects stays [read].
findings.cause: Parent subset check exists at child creation but is absent from case.revise and execution-time effect checks.
findings.impact: Task effect authority is bypassed through the ordinary linked-subtask workflow.

findings.title: Corrupt raw evidence of a consumed child does not stale or block parent acceptance
findings.input: Child performs real capture; parent consumes it through subtask.result. Parent obtains finite verify pass. Overwrite child's raw stdout CAS object, leaving sources unchanged.
findings.actual: read_material(child stdout) raises integrity-error. Parent report still acceptance=pass with integrity_failures=[], and case.close sets disposition=accepted. Negative control: corrupting parent's own raw stdout correctly makes report stale.
findings.cause: _check_dependencies refreshes only applicable_source_ids. _evidence_integrity starts at a verdict whose refs do not reach consumed subtask-result records.
findings.impact: P05 parent development can be accepted with damaged evidence from its registered research dependency.

findings.title: source.add writes beyond whole-workspace hard limit
findings.input: Initial census 69734 bytes; workspace.configure hard_bytes=269734, soft_bytes=169734, work_bytes=131072. Register a self-created 210000-byte source.
findings.actual: source.add returns success; census total_bytes=279734, hard_exceeded=true. Subsequent workspace.admit rejects workspace-budget, proving configured policy exists but was skipped by the controllable write.
findings.cause: Source import calls put_bytes directly; put_bytes enforces only separate CAS quota, not whole-workspace census/reservation.
findings.impact: Ordinary CLI inspect/source.add can exceed G06 hard budget before the professional execution admission check.
findings.handoff: Main informed and began core/workspace repair after this verified baseline. This report does not assess that later fix.

findings.title: A legitimate work-limit residual has no public path to a fresh inventory/archive
findings.input: Terminal cancelled run, cleanup=complete, owned L3 work_bytes=8192; create one 9000-byte residual and finish_directory. Attempt workspace.work.archive and workspace.work.clean. Raise work_bytes to16384 and retry archive.
findings.actual: Terminal item inventory_complete=false,recovery=true. Archive raises recovery-not-archived; clean keeps unarchived-recovery-payload. Increasing quota still does not refresh inventory and archive again fails. Residual remains.
findings.cause: finish_directory deliberately omits over-limit hashing, but the service exposes neither reinventory nor an alternate bounded residual archive path; archive requires the missing complete inventory.
findings.impact: The exact overflow state created by growth enforcement is measurable but stranded from ordinary recovery/reclamation. Retaining bytes is correct; missing finite recovery transition is the defect.
findings.handoff: Main informed and began workspace recovery repair after this baseline; no reread or duplicate experiments after handoff.

findings.title: Public compare returns pass after its raw source evidence is corrupt
findings.input: Use two real managed observations from a passing verify pair. Overwrite left stdout raw CAS object. Call compare on the same observation IDs and exact stdout obligation.
findings.actual: compare returns status=pass, although report on that parent returns stale with integrity-error for the same damaged streams.
findings.cause: compare passes saved capture dictionaries straight into the comparator without refreshing sources or reading referenced raw materials.
findings.impact: CLI/MCP users can receive a fresh-looking pass on a diagnostic path that skips the evidence integrity protection already present in report/close. This counterexample does not bypass case.close for parent-local raw damage.
